why: A is hasApproxProperty_restrict ∧ MChart.isClosed_inter_preimage, both at universe 0. hasApproxProperty_restrict gives the approximation property only for a chart restricted to an open s with cl_X(s) ⊆ dom φ. B is false (not_B, as its author predicted). It reads the text's 'the sc-smooth function f ∘ φ' literally, for every continuous f : O → [0, 1]. The refutation uses the one-chart M-polyfold ℝ (realPolyfold, chart id, model (ℝ, ℝ, ℝ)). That M-polyfold admits sc-smooth partitions of unity, by Mathlib's smooth partitions of unity on ℝ and C^∞ ⇒ sc-smooth. Take V = O = ℝ and f = min(|x|, 1); sc-smoothness on the constant scale ℝ is C^∞ (isScSmooth_iff_contDiffOn_const), but f is not differentiable at 0. So A ⇒ B is false (not_A_to_B), and B ⇒ A holds only ex falso. The author's second suspect, the claim cl_X(φ⁻¹(V)) ⊆ U, was not needed and was not formalized: on realPolyfold the chart is total. The author's sketch for it (a chart (0, 1) → ℝ) looks correct.
B_issue: B formalizes two evident slips of the text literally: 'the sc-smooth function f ∘ φ' (f is only continuous) and 'W = φ⁻¹(V) satisfying cl_X(W) ⊆ U' as a claim. The author flags both and supplies BRepaired. Refuted via the first slip on realPolyfold (not_B).
intended: BRepaired reads sc-smooth as continuous and takes cl_X(φ⁻¹(V)) ⊆ U as a hypothesis. BRepaired ⇒ A is proved (BRepaired_to_A, #rt_check OK, using the hypothesis). BRepaired's last conjunct says every chart of an atlas equivalent to the structure has a local model with the approximation property. Applied to the atlas of all charts of the structure and to the chart φ.restrict s, it gives hasApproxProperty_restrict, even without cl_X(s) ⊆ dom φ. The point-set lemma isClosed_inter_preimage is unrelated to B and is re-proved outright. A ⇒ BRepaired fails for a real reason. A gives the approximation property only for charts restricted to s with cl_X(s) ⊆ dom φ, not for every chart; the project explicitly leaves 'every chart' open. Settling it would need, for example, sc-smooth partitions of unity on open subsets of X: plausible via an sc-smooth exhaustion function, but substantial. Separately, A does not give BRepaired's specific approximant Σ_{x∈X} β_x ĝ(x), which would require re-running the project's proof (it uses the index type Option X, not X). Relation under this reading: A_narrower.
